title: Discrete Diffusion Schrodinger Bridge Matching for Graph Transformation
one_line_en: DDSBM extends Iterative Markovian Fitting to CTMCs on finite state spaces with a proof of monotone convergence to the Schrodinger bridge, and shows that with node/edge-independent reference dynamics the induced entropic-OT cost is proportional to the graph edit distance, applied to molecular optimization on ZINC250K and Polymer.
one_line_zh: DDSBM 把 Iterative Markovian Fitting 推广到有限状态空间的 CTMC 并证明其单调收敛到 Schrodinger 桥，指出当参考动力学取节点/边独立跳变时对应的熵正则 OT cost 正比于图编辑距离，应用于 ZINC250K 与 Polymer 上的分子优化。
